dialogue.content: ロールプレイ始めます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Let's begin the role-play. Thank you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。はじめに、年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 33歳、男です。仕事のことで悩んでます
dialogue.English: I’m 33, male. I’m struggling with work.

dialogue.content: 相談してくださってありがとうございます。お仕事のことで悩んでいらっしゃるのですね。もう少し詳しくお話していただくことはできますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out. So you're having difficulties with your work. Could you tell me a bit more about it?

dialogue.content: はい。仕事に対して、やる気が出ないんです。
dialogue.English: Yes. I just can't seem to find any motivation for my work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。やる気がでないんですね。特にどんな時にそう感じられるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. You’re feeling unmotivated. When do you particularly tend to feel that way?

dialogue.content: うーん。いつもですかねぇ
dialogue.English: Hmm… pretty much all the time, I guess.

dialogue.content: お仕事の間、ずっとということでしょうか。それはいつ頃からですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean throughout your entire workday? About how long has this been going on?

dialogue.content: なんとなく去年の夏くらいからです
dialogue.English: It's been sort of like this since around last summer.

dialogue.content: 何かきっかけのようなことはおありですか？
dialogue.English: Was there any particular trigger for it?

dialogue.content: 上司がかわってから、どんどん人が辞めていってしまっていることがきっかけといえばきっかけです
dialogue.English: Since my manager changed, people have been quitting one after another—if I had to name a trigger, that would be it.

dialogue.content: その時に何かをお感じになったということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And did you feel something specific at that time?

dialogue.content: うーん。徐々にって感じですかね？
dialogue.English: Hmm. It was more of a gradual thing, I guess.

dialogue.content: では、その時あたりから徐々に仕事に力が入らなくなってきてしまっている感じなんですね。
dialogue.English: So, you've been gradually feeling less and less engaged with your work since around that time.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それはしんどいですね。
dialogue.English: I see, that must be tough.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: では、ご自身では、今後少しでもこんな気持ちになりたいという思いはありますか？
dialogue.English: Going forward, is there a way you’d like to feel, even just a little?

dialogue.content: うーん。楽しく働きたいです
dialogue.English: Um… I’d like to enjoy my work.

dialogue.content: 楽しく！いいですね。
dialogue.English: Enjoying your work! That's a great goal.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 例えば、過去の仕事で今までにどんな時に楽しいと思いましたか？
dialogue.English: For example, in your work in the past, have there been times when you felt it was enjoyable?

dialogue.content: 納得が行くような仕事ができた時ですかねぇ
dialogue.English: I suppose when I was able to do work that I felt satisfied with.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。うん、それはきっと楽しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Yes, that must be very enjoyable.

dialogue.content: ですね
dialogue.English: It is.

dialogue.content: では、今は納得できることが少ないってことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, does that mean you now have fewer opportunities to feel satisfied with your work?

dialogue.content: そうですね...
dialogue.English: That's right...

dialogue.content: 前に納得できていたときと今で、違うことは何ですか？
dialogue.English: What’s different now compared to when you used to feel satisfied?

dialogue.content: 上司が変わりまして、今の上司はあんまり現場に関心がないのか上司の更に上にいい顔して、現場がどんどん大変になっていくんです
dialogue.English: My boss changed, and my current boss doesn't seem very interested in what's happening on the ground. They just try to look good for their own superiors, and it's making things more and more difficult for us.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは大変ですね。上にばかりいい顔をする上司なんて。
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds tough. A manager who only tries to look good to their higher-ups…

dialogue.content: 困ったもんです
dialogue.English: It’s a real problem.

dialogue.content: そうですね。仕事では上司を選べないし辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I agree. You can't choose your boss at work, so that must be tough.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: It is.

dialogue.content: う～ん。納得ができる仕事ができたら、気持ちもちょっと上向きになれますよね。
dialogue.English: Hmm. If you were able to do work you felt satisfied with, you might feel a bit more positive, right?

dialogue.content: でも今の状況じゃ納得のいく仕事どころじゃないんです
dialogue.English: But in this situation, being able to do satisfying work is out of the question.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。例えば具体的にはどんな状況が一番大変なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. For example, what specific situation is the most difficult for you?
